cases.shared: Separate deductor/deductee and collector/collectee evidence, assessed rule/certificate references, pooled certificate limits, amendments/status and settlement linkage.
cases.UAE: India TCS is unavailable for domestic UAE obligations. Use the common evidence/settlement foundations under an explicitly applicable obligation.
cases.India: Withholding liability and credit workflows now accept controlled assessed TCS populations; historical 1H date guards and role isolation are implemented.
cases.remaining: Native 27EQ/current-successor, 26AS/AIS/TRACES completeness, full legal rate/threshold/certificate corpus and representative client qualification.

cases.shared: Controlled BRS, account/owner evidence, ambiguity, opening/closing bridge, dates, outstanding carry-forward, subsequent clearance and cross-engagement cash-allocation checks.
cases.UAE: Authorized committed GL plus bounded reviewed CSV/XLSX/PDF and native bank profiles; account/currency scope remains explicit.
cases.India: Reuses the same reviewed account, statement, identifier/date and residual controls; no cross-account or currency auto-netting.
cases.remaining: Qualify representative bank-specific files and extraction accuracy; supported profiles do not imply every bank or every PDF layout.

cases.shared: Assessed contribution bases/rules, employer and employee component separation, expected obligation derivation and explicit split bank settlement.
cases.UAE: Separate WPS settlement and reviewed pension/benefit workflows; authority, cohort, eligibility and source documents are explicit.
cases.India: Monthly/arrear ECR and bounded ESIC population profiles, source-bound payroll rules and distinct PF/EPS/ESI/PT assessments are implemented.
cases.remaining: Complete qualified state/cohort packs, native challan coverage and representative portal/client files; administration/EDLI and legal deductibility must not be inferred from the current contribution workflow.

cases.shared: Versioned controlled tax documents, notes, independent source totals, registration/component/period separation and explicit missing/rejected evidence.
cases.UAE: VAT document comparison, VAT201 layouts/arithmetic, customs/import box bridge and reviewed book schedule composition reuse the UAE VAT workbench.
cases.India: Bounded GSTR-1 document/summary/series and GSTR-2B profiles, notes/amendments and controlled retrieval parts supplement canonical GST comparisons.
cases.remaining: Complete portal/schema qualification, legally assessed credit/recovery eligibility, full annual-return scope and authorized filing/action execution.

cases.shared: Distinct expected, withheld, reported, deposited and credit populations; source-bound assessments, pooled certificate controls and separate bank allocations.
cases.UAE: Indian domestic TDS workflows stay unavailable. Applicable UAE CT/obligation assessments use their own source-linked workbenches.
cases.India: Controlled deductor/deductee TDS liability/credit reconciliation and derived payment obligations are implemented, with no inferred legal entitlement.
cases.remaining: Native 24Q/26Q/27Q and successor forms, complete 26AS/AIS/TRACES profiles, current legal rate/threshold rules and professional expected schedules.

cases.shared: Declared report requirements, applicability, evidence-backed non-applicability, current-source validation, authorship separation and unsigned generated drafts.
cases.UAE: Source-linked CT workbench and audited-financial-statement obligation assessment; nonresident scoped revenue requires retained reviewed evidence.
cases.India: Tax-period-based legacy/current form selection and assessed applicability are enforced. The actual Form 26 and historical-form distinctions are retained in the source research.
cases.remaining: Complete independently approved clause/form manifests, statutory schedules and legal mappings. Declared requirements are not a complete official Form 26/3CD pack.

cases.shared: Tax-close evidence/readiness and exact finding-ID exposure deduplication. Currency/sign and unknown exposure remain distinct; stale sources cannot support current conclusions.
cases.UAE: Reviewed VAT/CT schedules plus registration-period turnover bridge, committed-GL books and reviewed multi-source book composition.
cases.India: GST/withholding/payroll evidence joins the same source-linked close. Turnover scope, return and adjustments remain independently reviewed inputs.
cases.remaining: Qualify complete country obligation/report packs and annual applicability; a reconciled close does not establish legal filing completeness.

cases.shared: Audit execution, retained evidence/workpapers, reviewed requirements, confirmations, cutoff, inventory/asset procedures and source-linked draft reporting.
cases.UAE: Country/framework binding and CT audit-obligation checks remain separate from licensing/free-zone/sector audit requirements.
cases.India: Schedule III/reporting foundations and form/applicability controls exist; India clauses are not reused as UAE requirements.
cases.remaining: Complete qualified Companies Act/CARO/IFC and UAE authority/sector reporting packs, actual physical/confirmation evidence and authorized professional issuance.

cases.shared: GRC risk/control/testing foundations plus retained SoD permission/assignment populations, reviewed policy, interval checks, paging, reporting and historical evidence.
cases.UAE: Common control review can be scoped to the entity; SOX remains an issuer/group/contractual overlay rather than a UAE default.
cases.India: Common control and SoD review can be scoped to IFC/ICFR or SOX as actually applicable; a country selection does not decide legal applicability.
cases.remaining: Authorized live enterprise-access/event connectors, complete framework-specific methods and professional design/operating-effectiveness conclusions.

cases.remaining: Licensed live registry/PEP/sanctions services, qualified local legal requirements, professional validators, consented partner pilots and any insurance/service arrangement.

cases.shared: Vendor identity/diligence, ownership and conflicts, uploaded-list screening, adverse-media evidence and separate procurement/payment controls.

cases.remaining: Authorized provider integrations, complete country diligence criteria and independently checked vendor cases; software cannot manufacture authenticity or professional attestation.

cases.remaining: Actual count attendance, title/condition/third-party evidence, industry-specific valuation methods and representative client qualification.
